The H.266 DCI parser API (gst_h266_parser_parse_dci) is compiled into libgstcodecparsers but has no call sites anywhere in gst-plugins-bad 1.26.2; no shipped plugin or element invokes it. Debian and the CVE description state that no standard GStreamer pipeline element uses this path (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-100229).
